panels.title: Reporting installations (7d)
panels.description: Distinct pseudonymous subjects. Subjects rotate daily, so this counts installations that reported in the window, never people.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqMerge(subjects) AS installations FROM nodera.events_hourly WHERE source = 'peer' AND hour >= $__fromTime AND hour < $__toTime

panels.title: Join success rate by path
panels.description: The reachability number. A drop on 'punched' with a rise on 'relayed' means hole punching is failing somewhere.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, path, round(100 * sum(success_count) / nullIf(sum(attempt_count), 0), 1) AS success FROM nodera.v_join_success WHERE hour >= $__fromTime AND hour < $__toTime GROUP BY time, path ORDER BY time

panels.title: Divergence fingerprints (daily)
panels.description: The determinism bet, measured. A fingerprint on many distinct subjects is a real engine bug in the wild; one on a single subject is usually a broken install.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, phase, fingerprint, agent, countMerge(reports) AS reports, uniqMerge(subjects) AS installs FROM nodera.divergence_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) GROUP BY day, phase, fingerprint, agent ORDER BY installs DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Where the network is
panels.description: Coarse geography only: country and ASN, derived at ingest from an address that is never stored.

targets.rawSql: SELECT country, uniqMerge(subjects) AS installations FROM nodera.events_hourly WHERE source = 'peer' AND hour >= $__fromTime GROUP BY country ORDER BY installations DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Service throughput (tracker + rendezvous)
panels.description: Reported by the services themselves, one window event per minute each.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, source, sum(event_count) AS reports FROM nodera.v_events_hourly WHERE source IN ('tracker','rendezvous') AND hour >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, source ORDER BY time
